title: Privacy Policy – Spin the Wheel
description: What Spin the Wheel collects, what a generation sends to its server, and how to ask for deletion, in plain language.
heroText: Short version: every tool on this site runs on your device. This page explains what the site counts, what a contact message keeps, and how to have data removed.

sections.title: Where your work happens
sections.body: Splitting teams, the wheel and the preset tools run in your browser on your device; those runs are not sent anywhere and are not stored. No tool on this site uploads your list or your entries.

sections.title: What is collected
sections.body: No account is needed for anything on the site, and no email is asked for. The site counts anonymous, aggregate usage events — that a spin started and finished, never the entries themselves — to steer what gets fixed next. Messages sent through the [contact form](/contact/) are kept so the owner can read and answer them.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.body: You can ask for a message you sent to be deleted through the contact form. The site does not sell data and does not run advertising networks on the tool pages. The [terms of use](/terms/) govern your use of the site.
